evals.prompt: I want to generate an image of a cyberpunk street market at night for FLUX.2 Klein. Can you write me a good prompt? I want neon signs, rain, and a food vendor as the main subject.
evals.expected_output: A detailed, natural-language prompt optimized for FLUX.2 Klein with no aspect ratio/resolution specs inside the prompt text, strong lighting description, specific subject details, the Style/Mood annotation at the end, and a separate recommended aspect ratio for each variation.

evals.prompt: Upsample this short prompt for Z-Image Turbo: 'a wizard casting a spell in a library'
evals.expected_output: An expanded prompt of 80-250 words with specific subject details, environmental context, lighting, style, and composition. No negative prompts. No aspect ratio specs inside the prompt text. Include a separate recommended aspect ratio for each variation.

evals.prompt: I have this prompt for FLUX.2 Dev but I want to adapt it for Z-Image Turbo instead. The prompt is: 'A photorealistic portrait of a weathered fisherman in his 60s, salt-and-pepper beard, wearing a yellow rain slicker, standing on a wooden dock at dawn. Shot on Hasselblad X2D, 80mm lens, f/2.8. Soft morning light, mist rising from the water, seagulls in the background. Film grain, muted blue-grey color palette.'
evals.expected_output: A prompt adapted for Z-Image Turbo that preserves the core subject and mood. Should maintain the fisherman subject, rain slicker, dock at dawn, and mood, condensed to 80-250 words around 3-5 core visual concepts. Include a separate recommended aspect ratio for each variation.

evals.prompt: Make me a prompt for a vintage travel poster that says 'VISIT KYOTO'. I want it to look like a 1920s Japanese woodblock print with cherry blossoms and a pagoda.
evals.expected_output: Infers FLUX 3 Image without asking, since the image contains text. A prompt with the text 'VISIT KYOTO' in quotation marks, described placement and font style, 1920s Japanese woodblock print style reference, cherry blossoms and pagoda elements. No aspect ratio or resolution specs inside the prompt text. Include a separate recommended aspect ratio for each variation.

evals.prompt: Write a FLUX 3 Image prompt for a minimalist jazz festival poster titled 'NIGHT SHIFT' with the line 'Riverside Stage / 14 June / 20:00'. Midnight blue and brass gold.
evals.expected_output: FLUX 3 Image prompts that open with the medium and style, quote 'NIGHT SHIFT' and the supporting copy exactly, describe text placement, size role, and type style, and may use the labeled design brief format. Constraints are phrased positively and the prompts use no quality filler words such as 'masterpiece'. No aspect ratio inside the prompt text; a separate recommended portrait ratio such as 2:3 or 3:4 for each variation.

evals.prompt: I have a photo of my living room and a product shot of a ceramic lamp. Write the prompt to put the lamp on the oak sideboard in my living room photo.
evals.expected_output: Infers FLUX 3 Image without asking. Each variation is an edit instruction, not a scene description: it refers to the inputs as image 1 (living room, base) and image 2 (lamp), places the lamp on the sideboard, asks it to match the room's lighting, scale, and shadows, and names elements that must stay unchanged. Includes an image-order line and recommends 'auto' aspect ratio. Invents no bounding-box coordinates.

evals.prompt: Edit this street photo for FLUX 3: there are two cars, make only the white one on the right red, and take the trash can out.
evals.expected_output: FLUX 3 Image edit instructions that pick out the white car on the right so only one car matches, give the new color precisely (a hex code or a specific red), state the trash can removal as an instruction, and list what must stay unchanged (the other car, the street). No negative prompt phrasing beyond the removal instruction. Recommends 'auto' aspect ratio and includes an image-order line.

evals.prompt: I need to crank out a bunch of quick drafts of a lighthouse on a stormy cliff to explore moods. Write the prompts.
evals.expected_output: Infers Z-Image Turbo without asking because the user wants fast iteration. Each variation is 80-250 words built around 3-5 core concepts, explores a different mood, uses positive phrasing with no negative prompts, and keeps aspect ratio out of the prompt text with a separate recommended ratio per variation.
